title: Knobby Crunchy German Spinach Skillet
description: A pungent and crunchy German dish featuring spinach and candy, perfect for a vegan-friendly brunch, served on a hot stone plate.

ingredients.name: vegan candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as gummies or sour candies

instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh spinach and cook until it is wilted.
Stir in the nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Add the vegan candy pieces and stir well.
Sprinkle the potato starch over the top of the spinach mixture and stir well.
Remove the hot stone plate from the oven and carefully place the skillet on top of it.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the top of the spinach mixture.
Return the hot stone plate to the oven and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
